scope: All 208 existing audit families, classified by primary work rather than completion status. This is not a complete inventory of every app-development backlog item.
rules: Game factual research includes game behavior, journal content, source verification, edition/build evidence and declared content exclusions.
App development includes implementing or exposing facts already known, generators/parsers/indexes, app documentation, planners, saved state, artwork, device/offline testing and Jiminy.
Mixed families get one primary assignment to prevent double counting. Their original disposition and linked factual dependencies remain visible; classification does not close or reopen findings.
Game save/counter behavior and Steam game controls are game research; our app persistence and UI controls are app development.
Evidence limitations and exclusions are not eight new unknown mechanics or eight automatically actionable tasks.

Evidence counts retain optional deferrals and unresolved practical questions. The strict non-CoM review covers all 65 starting residual families: 2 resolved, 52 with optional residual precision deferred, and 11 open. KH1 decisions are preserved; concurrent CoM records are integrated through cdbc462. Practical disposition is separate from evidence status.
